text:
sara: heads-up — seeing ~20% mTLS handshake failures between proxy-ingress and model-router in eu-west-1 since 09:15UTC. Error traces show KMS Decrypt denies. Anyone touch keystore RBAC last night? :warning:

oncall-bot: alert fired: mtls_handshake_failures > 10 in 5m for eu-west-1, incident #INC-2026-014 created.

devon: I pushed a keystore role tighten PR (r: @mike) yesterday to remove `kms:Decrypt` from the service_account used by model-router — PR #4123. Probably the cause.

mike: confirming — that was intentional to scope down perms. didn't expect cross-region calls to use that principal. logs snippet:
```
2026-03-22T09:16:14Z service=model-router error="kms:DecryptDenied" principal="svc-account:model-router@redwood" region=eu-west-1 request_id=8f3a
```

irina: immediate mitigations: 1) rollback PR or 2) add a temporary role binding granting kms:Decrypt to the model-router principal in eu-west. Also enable structured audit for keystore:Decrypt denies: `audit.log.filter=keystore.decrypt` so we can correlate.

sara: can we do a quick canary rollback to restore previous role scope? If not, grant temporary allow and we'll follow up with least-priv redesign.

devon: can rollback quickly. but need approvals for re-opening the wide scope. I can reapply old policy to eu-west service account via infra-playbook: `infra apply -t eu-west keystore-policy@stable` — will do if oncall says go.

ben: +1 to temporary allow. Also flagging that the proxy has a fallback path that tries to route to us-east; we saw increased latency as it retried. Recommend adding explicit region-affinity to avoid cross-region KMS calls while we fix this.

mike: doing the temporary binding now, will post audit event and rollback token. ETA 6 mins.

oncall-bot: action logged: grant role keystore-decrypt to svc-account:model-router@eu-west-1 by mike at 2026-03-22T09:22:05Z. Monitoring for handshake recovery.

sara: update — failures down to ~1% after binding. please open a followup to redesign keystore delegation: `sec-ops#ticket-182` — include options: regional keystores, double-sign, token exchange.

devon: noted. will add runbook entry for RBAC change checklist: pre-flight audit queries, impact matrix, and auto-notify if mtls errors spike >5% in 10m. Assigning to me.
